Her actual question, whether she lost top spenders, was never answered directly, and whale retention was her top agenda item on Aug 6. Invoice 5 (Sep 15-30) went out Oct 1 at 15:21. It is unpaid at window close but less than 18 hours old, not chased and not overdue. As before, no standalone banking block, no Chase fraud-flag acknowledgement (now 32 days) and no ad-spend report came before it. Still open with no movement: plaintext IG/Snapchat credentials in the scrollback (21 days, not rotated), written content-boundary confirmation (61 days), livestream (42 days), trial-reel and Facebook campaign numbers, and Derrek silent for 36 days. CHURN READ: easing from HIGH to ELEVATED. The quiet signal reversed: she is engaged, chasing and cooperative, and finished the intake form fast. No asks for exports or logins, and no mention of another agency. Remaining tells: the outside nuropod.com link (nobody asked what it is), self-blocking harassers, and an unanswered question about lost top spenders.

Signal (d) other agencies or 'doing it myself': weak, only 'I’m just blocking the accounts that send these' and the unexplained nuropod.com outside link.
